# Nois(ampl)e keyboard sample credits

These recordings belong to the **generated keyboard accompaniment** that enters after all six microphone roles are filled. Microphone recordings remain the source of the six percussion lanes; these files never replace them.

- **Grand Piano:** Salamander Grand Piano v3, Alexander Holm, [CC BY 3.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/). Original source: [sfzinstruments/SalamanderGrandPiano](https://github.com/sfzinstruments/SalamanderGrandPiano), revision `3382bf9496bba2486f5ab0de55a264d1dfc38404`.
- **FM Piano, Marimba, Vibraphone:** Versilian Community Sample Library, Versilian Studios LLC and contributors, [CC0 1.0](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/). Original source: [sgossner/VCSL](https://github.com/sgossner/VCSL), revision `c1ea7bcc3c7309650ab0da9d15c9cd1fbc4a4c7e`.

The compact MP3 recordings were prepared for [Loopify](https://github.com/TaewoooPark/loopify) and copied from revision `97e5f10f4bd7694101f2f2c319f8a755d3699ee3`. Four existing root recordings per instrument are included, with their MP3 bytes unchanged. At runtime, decoded recordings retain at most 3.2 seconds to bound mobile memory; keyboard note envelopes and nearest-root resampling set their musical articulation and pitch. This treatment applies only to the accompaniment, never to captured microphone audio.

See [the complete preparation credits](./LOOPIFY-CREDITS.txt), [individual source URLs and SHA-256 checksums](./SOURCES.json), and [license texts](./licenses). No endorsement by the original creators is implied.
